title: Coasting prohibited.
bodyText: The driver of any motor vehicle when traveling upon a down grade shall not coast with the gears or transmission of the vehicle in neutral or with the clutch disengaged.
bodyHtml: [§291C-127]  Coasting prohibited.  The driver of any motor vehicle when traveling upon a down grade shall not coast with the gears or transmission of the vehicle in neutral or with the clutch disengaged. [L 1971, c 150, pt of §1]
